about: By Archive item, from the PLAY assistant (audit assistant-tools/fame.js and front-rank, no AI; it changes slowly): pages, how many Wikipedia languages have a page on the game; known, the items Wikidata lists under that very name on that machine with 10 or more pages; game, the Wikidata entry, so two names or copies of one game count once. play/tools/shelf.js ranks each machine by it with the Archive play counts (Bryan, 22 Nov 2026: "Yes, best 40 each"; "increase the number of that console or system to fit the games").
